items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Uh, we had Eddie Pearson on the trombone, uh, at that time and a fellow by the name of Yank.

ctx.x: Uh, we had Eddie Pearson on the trombone, uh, at that time and a fellow by the name of Yank. Who was this with? The trombone. We, uh, with Celestan. And, uh… When did Yank die? Do you know?
Our buddy Johnson, either one of those trombones, his brothers? Uh, Yank died. I'd say it must have been around 1938.
